mapper.select: SELECT pr.product_type AS productType, COUNT(CASE WHEN ro.return_request = 0 THEN pr.product_type END) AS refundedNum, COUNT(CASE WHEN ro.return_request = 1 THEN pr.product_type END) AS repairedNum, COUNT(CASE WHEN ro.return_request = 2 THEN pr.product_type END) AS recycledNum FROM storage AS st LEFT JOIN product AS pr ON st.product_id = pr.product_id LEFT JOIN return_order AS ro ON st.return_order_num = ro.return_order_num GROUP BY pr.product_type

SELECT ro.postcode FROM storage AS st LEFT JOIN operate AS op ON st.storage_id = op.storage_id LEFT JOIN return_order AS ro ON st.return_order_num = ro.return_order_num
AND YEAR(op.operate_time) = #{year}
